notes.title: 50 Wishlist's and Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is the first "News" that I am posting here on Steam. First, I want to say thank you so much for the wishlists and support from around the world, including all the feedback and more.

My goal was to get 20-40 wishlists by Christmas, but that goal has already been surpassed. I'm so happy!

[i][b]In-Game Footage[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269572/8d08da32500999165b75a6a61efed5f9c1dd0eb2.png[/img]

The current update for November and December includes:

- Added camera tilt.
- Slow motion effect (kill cam).
- Improved critical hit (normal, stronger, and epic).
- Smoother attack rotation.
- Added "bow" weapon and corrected the "arrows" direction.
- Improved shop with labor point system.

And there were some more.


[i][b]Here is the Devlog I did released about example Camera tilt and more.[/b][/i]
[previewyoutube=zIF2msYO_wA;full][/previewyoutube]

Have a great Christmas and a Happy New Year!
